items.t: Could GE Vernova (GEV) Gain From A $97 Million AI Infrastructure Rollout?
items.sum: BrightAI secured US$97 million in new funding to roll out its AI infrastructure platform with GE Vernova (NYSE:GEV) as a core partner. GE Vernova plans to deploy BrightAI's real time, predictive maintenance tools across its Power, Wind, and Electrification operations. The collaboration focuses on AI driven monitoring of turbines, grids, and related hardware to support asset uptime and maintenance
